title: Krea 2 Turbo (public line)
description: 8-step distilled Krea 2 Turbo text-to-image worker: one prompt in, one 1K PNG out. The schedule is pinned at 8 steps / CFG 0, the prompt expander is not used, and the age rule runs before any GPU work.

input.name: Checkpoint path
input.description: Path to the Krea 2 Turbo DiT inside the worker. An fp8_scaled safetensors file is dequantised to bf16 once, beside the source, on the worker's first load.

input.name: Hugging Face cache
input.description: Where the Qwen3-VL encoder and the Qwen-Image VAE are cached after their first download. Point it at the same volume as the checkpoint so a warm worker is not paying for them again.
